title: Creamy Corn Confit Bake
description: A rich and comforting dish made with creamy corn, tender confit, and a crispy crust.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the confit, corn, creamy, salt, and black pepper. Stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish.
In a small bowl, mix the breadcrumbs and melted butter.
Sprinkle the breadcrumb mixture evenly over the top of the confit mixture.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the mixture is heated through.
